title: Coffee camera prompt A/B
core_message: water visibly reveals coffee through a continuous physical process
visual_style: photoreal macro product cinematography, dark walnut and espresso palette, warm side backlight

shots.subject_action: water drop transforms coffee grounds into coffee
shots.generation_prompt: Cinematic macro coffee advertisement. A drop of cold water falls onto coffee grounds and turns into coffee. The camera moves dynamically around the scene, zooming in and out with dramatic cinematic lighting. High-end commercial quality, rich brown tones, realistic liquid, beautiful smooth motion, 15 seconds, no text or watermark. Internal shot timeline: show the event during the 15 seconds. Continuity lock: keep coffee material consistent. Never show: readable text, logo, watermark. Final 1 seconds hold on coffee liquid.

shots.start_framing: top-down macro water drop over grounds
shots.end_framing: shallow side close-up of stable coffee surface
shots.continuity_out: stable coffee surface and glass edge
shots.subject_action: visible capillary wetting and liquid-channel merge
shots.generation_prompt:
MAIN VISUAL TASK
Follow one cold-water drop as it visibly wets coffee grounds and reveals a continuous dark coffee surface.

PROMPT BIBLE / CONTINUITY LOCK
Subject: the same bed of coarse dark-roasted coffee grounds and one clear cold-water drop
Environment: dark walnut tabletop, seamless black background, no people
Materials: real granular coffee grounds, transparent water, visibly wet porous coffee, dark brown coffee liquid
Lighting: warm narrow side backlight from upper right, faint cool fill from left, no lighting change
Palette: espresso brown, walnut brown, warm amber highlights, black background
Lens and texture: photoreal macro cinema lens, shallow depth of field, natural micro-texture, no CGI geometry
Screen direction: water and camera travel from upper center downward; preserve direction throughout
Audio policy: close-miked water drop, wet absorption and low room tone; no music, no voice

INTERNAL SHOT TIMELINE
0-3s | extreme_close_up | visual state: dry coffee granules fill the frame and one clear drop hangs above them | subject action: the drop slowly descends toward a visible pore between granules | camera: locked macro start, then a very short downward tracking motion begins | focus: drop surface and the exact contact point | lighting: warm rim light reveals transparent water and oily coffee texture | end state: drop is one millimeter above the grounds
3-6s | extreme_close_up | visual state: the drop touches the dry porous surface | subject action: water flattens, enters gaps and creates an irregular wet edge | camera: track downward with the contact, no cut and no orbit | focus: contact line and granular capillary absorption | lighting: same fixed side backlight | end state: a small dark wet patch is clearly visible
6-10s | close_up | visual state: wet patch expands through connected coffee granules | subject action: thin real liquid channels merge; granules darken progressively from center outward | camera: continue one smooth arc fifteen degrees to the right while slowly pulling back | focus: rack focus from the leading wet edge to connected liquid channels | lighting: same light direction, amber highlights move only because camera moves | end state: several channels have merged into one coherent dark pool
10-13s | medium_close_up | visual state: the coherent coffee pool now reveals the curved edge of a glass vessel | subject action: the liquid surface rises slightly and settles with small physical ripples | camera: complete the same pullback and lower to a shallow side angle | focus: transition from wet grounds to the complete liquid surface and glass edge | lighting: warm rim outlines the glass edge, cool fill preserves liquid detail | end state: the whole coffee surface and glass edge are readable
13-15s | medium_close_up | visual state: stable dark coffee surface inside the same glass edge | subject action: ripples decelerate naturally until almost still | camera: camera decelerates to a complete stop | focus: locked on the surface highlight and glass edge | lighting: unchanged | end state: clean stable endpoint for a matched edit

CAMERA PATH
Motivation: the camera behaves like an observer following the physical cause from drop to absorbed liquid, then reveals the result
Start position: top-down macro, six centimeters above the coffee grounds
Primary move: tracking
Physical path: track down with the drop, continue into a shallow fifteen-degree right arc, then pull back and lower to reveal the glass edge
Speed curve: very slow opening, brief medium acceleration at contact, smooth slow pullback, full deceleration for the final two seconds
Focus transition: drop surface to contact edge to connected liquid channels to full coffee surface and glass edge
End position: shallow thirty-degree side angle, medium close-up of coffee surface and glass edge
Axis lock: never cross the water travel axis; downward motion stays downward on screen
Stop condition: stop only after the liquid ripples have visibly settled

FIRST FRAME
dry coffee grounds in extreme macro with one transparent water drop above the exact center contact point

LAST FRAME
stable dark coffee surface and curved glass edge, no text, no logo, no camera motion

FINAL 2 SECONDS HOLD
All subject and camera movement decelerates to a stable, editable end state.

NEVER SHOW
readable text, logo, watermark, UI, blue title card, blocks or geometric placeholders, people, instant magical transformation
acceptance_tests: coffee grounds remain material, never blocks
